title: AI calendar assistant over MCP: tools from an MCP server on a live call, scoped by the token
alias: MCP client in a voice AI agent
also_known_as: MCP tools on a phone call
summary: A calendar assistant demo built to show MCP tools reaching a live call through one add_mcp_server call. The bearer token sets the tool list, the server holds the rules, and a caller ID signature keeps meetings to their owner.
scenario: A phone line books and moves appointments with calendar tools that live behind an MCP server the platform connects to at call start
